# Use a local database

## Status

Accepted

## Context and Problem Statement

The tool needs a portable local store.

## Decision Drivers

- Keep setup simple.

## Considered Options

- SQLite
- PostgreSQL

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: SQLite.

## Consequences

- The database is local to each checkout.

## Pros and Cons of the Options

### SQLite

- Good, because SQLite is portable.

None.
